assets.content:
Subject: Build your first seasonal banner pair
Preview text: Send two product-data inputs through one fixed image template.

Turn two product inputs into two seasonal banners

Hi there,

Bannerbear’s Image API renders ecommerce banners from templates and supplied data. Begin with one seasonal image template and prepare two product-data inputs.

For the first banner, send an authenticated POST request to the Image API’s `/v5/images` endpoint with your API key and the first product’s `IMAGE_DATA`. For the second, keep the template choice fixed and replace the product data in the request body.

That gives you one bounded workflow: configure the design once, then use each request to supply the content for a different seasonal product-banner variant.

Open the documented REST API and OpenAPI specifications to structure those first two requests. The reference shows the implementation details behind each render: https://developers.bannerbear.com/v5/

Open the API Reference → https://developers.bannerbear.com/v5/

- Bannerbear

Enterprise plan costs $299 USD per month
The Enterprise plan includes SSO, Audit Logs, Zero Data Retention and Priority Support
Animations are billed at 2 credits per second of output, rounded up to the next whole second, with a minimum of 1 credit; a 4.2 second animation costs 10 credits
Burning subtitles costs 4 credits because it both transcribes the audio and re-encodes the video
Requesting multiple output formats costs more credits: asking for jpg and png together costs two credits rather than one, because credits are counted per format
Rendering at a higher resolution via the scale parameter also multiplies the credit cost — e.g. a scale of 2 on a 1200x630 template returns 2400x1260 output and multiplies credits by the scale
AI face/subject detection costs one extra credit per layer that uses it, on top of the render itself
Background removal on an uploaded photo can be enabled at render time and costs one credit per layer

intelligence.selected_audience: Marketing/growth team at an ecommerce or SaaS company
partial_caveats_injected: Design the branded template(s) once in the workspace before any render
Connect the data source through a native integration (e.g. Airtable) or Zapier, or call the documented REST API directly
Budget credits per render: each requested format counts separately and the scale parameter multiplies credits
Trial accounts are limited to one workspace, three image templates, three animation templates, three workflows and three instant URLs

Volume is metered in credits (1,000/mo on Automate at $49, 10,000 on Scale at $149, with extra credits per additional format, per scale multiple and per AI layer), and of the named feed sources only Airtable (plus Notion, WordPress, Ghost) is documented as native — Google Sheets and a generic CMS are not established by the selected evidence except via the Zapier branch.
